question: Which country keys the original reads back from a save, for OpenHOI3's sweep of its save loader.

addresses.name: CCountry::LoadKey
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CCountry::LoadKey(CCountry* this, CParseContext* parse, SaveToken key)
addresses.comment: Slot 4 of CPersistent for a country: one key from a save, dispatched on its token id through a tree of comparisons. The value is the CToken at parse +0x228, so a number is read straight out of parse +0x22C. The mirror of CCountry::SaveContents, and the other place a field's save key can be read off. **The keys it names**, read 2026-11-14 with scripts/switchmap.py over the whole tree of comparisons - 126 cases, the closing brace and one token the table does not name among them: `color`, `duration`, `history`, `manpower`, `capital`, `technology`, `government`, `distribution`, `army`, `navy`, `home`, `leader`, `spies`, `building_construction`, `military_construction`, `graphical_culture`, `declarewar`, `allianceaction`, `guaranteeaction`, `milaccess`, `offermilaccess`, `war_exhaustion`, `callaction`, `modifier`, `to`, `flags`, `back`, `color2`, `variables`, `ideology`, `ministers`, `air`, `research`, `theatre`, `armygroup`, `corps`, `division`, `pool`, `leadership`, `influence`, `unit_deployment`, `building_deployment`, `escorts`, `convoys`, `convoy`, `convoy_construction`, `popularity`, `unit_names`, `officers`, `auto_maintain_convoy`, `auto_supply_convoy`, `auto_resource_convoy`, `nukes`, `mobilize`, `government_in_exile`, `strategic_warfare`, `acting_capital`, `default_templates`, `saved_templates`, `auto_assign_leaders`, `usage`, `active_leaders`, `convoyed_out`, `traded_for`, `traded_away`, `ai`, `human`, `active_mission`, `last_mission_cancel`, `last_election`, `slider_locks`, `major`, `last_rebel_acceptance`, `remove_fow`, `last_mission`, `historical_friends`, `ai_hard_strategy`, `ai_event_strategy`, `alignment`, `organization`, `dissent`, `national_unity`, `neutrality`, `election`, `nap`, `diplo_influence`, `influence_leaders`, `embargo_action`, `faction_action`, `trade_action`, `spy_priority`, `spy_allocation`, `spy_mission`, `spy_date`, `send_expedition`, `licence_technology`, `debtaction_action`, `peace_action`, `prov_vp`, `offmap_vp`, `spiescaught`, `share_technology`, `shared_technologies`, `traded_for_sans_allied`, `traded_away_sans_allied`, `land_battles_fought`, `air_battles_fought`, `naval_battles_fought`, `cabinet`, `effective_neutrality`, `highest_threat`, `last_surrender`, `request_lendlease`, `lendlease_targets`, `lendlease_distributions`, `covert_ops_points`, `lendlease_effectiveness`, `lend_lease_from`, `lend_lease_from_values`, `lend_lease_from_yesterday`, `lend_lease_from_yesterday_values`, `lend_lease_income`, `lend_lease_income_yesterday`, `offer_lendlease`. A technology category's name (`nocategory` among them), a law group's, a post's and another country's tag are not cases, so they are resolved past the switch (*inferred*: the default arm was not followed). Every country key in the maintainer's saves is a case, `human`, `prov_vp`, `offmap_vp`, `last_mission_cancel`, `trade_action`, `influence` and the three `*_yesterday` lend-lease keys among them, so the original reads all of them back. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-savegame.md, B.4.
